scenes.title: Hook: two unlike triangles
scenes.purpose: [hook-paradox] The surprising claim as two objects side by side.
scenes.why: States the claim the proof explains.
scenes.visual: Two unlike triangles draw; their angles grow; both count to 180.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

scenes.title: Setup: name the angles
scenes.purpose: [setup] Build the object and colour each variable once.
on_screen_text: Call the three angles a, b and c.
scenes.visual: One triangle draws; angles a, b, c grow from their vertices in their colours.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Construct: the parallel line
scenes.purpose: [construct] One visible change: the parallel line.
scenes.why: Adds the one construction the proof needs.
on_screen_text: Draw a line through the top, parallel to the base.
scenes.visual: Parallel line draws through the apex; parallel marks; a and b pulse.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Turn: half-turns
scenes.purpose: [turn] The key move: a and b turn half a turn onto the line.
on_screen_text: Turn a and b half a turn. They land beside c, on a straight line.
scenes.visual: A copy of a turns 180 degrees about the midpoint of AC; then b about the midpoint of BC; the straight line thickens; the fan pulses.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Result over a moving apex
scenes.purpose: [result] Restate the claim over the final state, which keeps moving.
scenes.why: Shows it holds for any triangle.
scenes.visual: Equation rises; the apex slides along the parallel line and every angle follows.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.
